newsitem.title: NEPAL: UNFPA pledges $34.8 mln to Nepal population plans.
newsitem.headline: UNFPA pledges $34.8 mln to Nepal population plans.

text.p: The United Nations Fund for Population Activities (UNFPA) will provide 1.98 billion rupees in grants to support population programmes in Nepal, a Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday.
The official said the UNFPA funds will be used over a period of five years for reproductive health and family planning in the kingdom with 2.5 percent population growth rate.
Nepal, one of the world's poorest nations, receives over 60 percent of the cost of its economic development from Western donors including UN agencies.
